Dem Coeff, SE, p:
```{r}
library(multcomp)

DemCoeffs <- c()
DemSEs <- c()
DemPs <- c()

for(i in 1:70){
  testsum <- summary(glht(models[[i]], "headline_true:treated+headline_true:treated:demrep=0"))
  DemCoeffs <- append(DemCoeffs, testsum$test$coefficients)
  DemSEs <- append(DemSEs, testsum$test$sigma)
  DemPs <- append(DemPs, testsum$test$pvalues[1])
}

model_names <- discern_coefs$model

dem_discern_coeffs <- data.frame(model_names, DemCoeffs, DemSEs, DemPs)
#write.csv(dem_discern_coeffs, "dem_discern_coeffsSE.csv")
```

```{r}
min(dem_discern_coeffs$DemCoeffs)
max(dem_discern_coeffs$DemCoeffs)
```
